title: done event
description: Final event of a successful backend run (ARCHITECTURE 4.2). Optional fields carry command results: `path` for `get`, `freed_bytes` for `remove`, `clipboard_history_contains_code` for `login-finish` (ARCHITECTURE 4.7), and `acked` for conditional books-location acknowledgement. `warning` is a stable code for a non-fatal problem (B13: `activation_bytes` when `login-finish` saved the login but could not fetch the account-wide AAX key).
